name: get_current_time
description: Returns the authoritative current local date and time from this computer. Use this whenever the user asks for the current time or date; do not guess. Default timezone is Asia/Kolkata (IST).

name: show_desktop_notification
description: Shows a custom purple desktop popup notification card in the bottom-right corner of the screen with a title, message, and alert chime, also sending a Windows Action Center toast.

name: get_network_status
description: Checks network connectivity, connected Wi-Fi network SSID, signal strength percentage, link speed, local IP address, and ping latency to the internet.

name: set_reminder_timer
description: Schedules a proactive timer or reminder that will alert the user after a given number of minutes with an on-screen purple notification popup card and an alert chime.

name: list_active_reminders
description: Lists all currently pending reminders and timers with their remaining time and reminder IDs.

name: cancel_reminder_timer
description: Cancels an active reminder or timer by its reminder ID or partial reminder text.

name: set_display_brightness
description: Sets the display screen brightness percentage between 10 and 100 percent. Works universally across external desktop monitors, laptops, and HDMI/DisplayPort screens.

name: get_display_brightness
description: Checks and returns the current estimated screen display brightness percentage.

name: read_file
description: Reads text contents from a local file safely. Supports path shortcuts like '~/Desktop'. Optionally specify start_line and end_line for surgical code reading.

name: edit_file
description: Surgically edits a file by finding an exact target snippet and replacing it with the replacement snippet. Guarantees safety without rewriting the entire file.

path.description: Path to the file to modify.

target.description: The exact string or code block to find and replace. Must match whitespace/indentation exactly.

replacement.description: The replacement string or code block.

name: search_codebase
description: Searches for text, function names, variables, or error strings across all source files in a directory (like ripgrep/grep), returning matching files and line numbers.

query.description: The text, function name, or variable to search for.

search_directory.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to current workspace ('.').

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return (default 30).

name: trace_git_changes
description: Performs deep forensic inspection on a Git repository: inspects recent commits, unstaged changes, modified files, diff summaries, or what changed since last night.

mode.description: Inspection mode: 'status' (changed files), 'recent_commits' (commit history), 'diff' (stat of changed lines), or 'last_night' (changes since yesterday).

max_commits.description: Number of commits to inspect in 'recent_commits' mode (default 5).

name: write_file
description: Writes text content to a local file, creating parent directories automatically.

name: append_to_file
description: Appends a note or text to a file with an automatic timestamp (great for logs or notes).

name: list_folder
description: Lists files and subdirectories in a directory with file sizes and modified dates.

name: search_files
description: Searches for files matching a filename or extension pattern recursively.

name: recycle_file
description: Safely moves a file or folder to the Windows Recycle Bin (never permanently deletes).

name: write_to_notepad
description: Writes or replaces text in Notepad and opens it immediately on screen (ideal for writing out conversation transcripts, notes, code, or logs).

name: read_document
description: Extracts and reads full text content from documents, PDFs (.pdf via pdf-parse), Word documents (.docx via mammoth), or image files (.png/.jpg via OCR) in the background without needing to open them.

path.description: Path to the document or image file (supports .pdf, .docx, .txt, .md, .csv, .json, .png, .jpg).

name: copy_to_clipboard
description: Copies text or content to the Windows system clipboard.

name: get_clipboard
description: Reads current text content from the Windows clipboard.

name: press_keyboard_hotkey
description: Sends a keyboard shortcut combination to the active window (e.g. 'ctrl+c', 'ctrl+v', 'alt+tab', 'win+d', 'ctrl+s').

name: type_text
description: Types text into the currently focused window or text box.

name: paste_text
description: Pastes text or a file path directly into the active window or an optionally focused target window via clipboard Ctrl+V.

text.description: The exact text or file path to paste.

window_title.description: Optional title or name of the window to bring to the foreground and focus before pasting (e.g. 'Notepad', 'Chrome', 'Terminal', 'Explorer').

name: move_mouse
description: Moves the mouse cursor to specific (x, y) coordinates on the screen with smooth gliding motion.

name: click_mouse
description: Clicks the mouse button at specified (x, y) coordinates or at the current mouse position (supports single, double, and right click).

name: scroll_mouse
description: Scrolls the mouse wheel up or down on the currently hovered window or page.

name: get_mouse_position
description: Returns the current mouse cursor (x, y) coordinates and current screen resolution width and height.

name: execute_powershell_script
description: Executes a PowerShell command or script to inspect, configure, or repair the system. You autonomously decide the expected timeout_seconds based on the nature of the task (e.g. 5-15s for quick queries, 60-120s for disk searches/downloads, 300-600s for deep system scans like sfc or chkdsk).

command.description: Short description of what is being executed.

timeout_seconds.description: The maximum duration in seconds to wait for output before cancelling. Estimate this dynamically based on the command.

name: execute_powershell_script_visible
description: Opens a visible PowerShell console in the foreground and runs the requested PowerShell command or script in it. Use only when the user explicitly asks to open/show PowerShell or run it visibly in front of them.

code.description: The exact PowerShell script to run visibly.

name: execute_command
description: Executes a Windows shell / CMD command or batch script (e.g. 'dir', 'ipconfig', 'netstat', 'ping', 'where'). Captures stdout and stderr.

name: save_automation_script
description: Saves a reusable automation script (PowerShell or Batch) to MEERA's persistent library so it can be re-run at any time by name.

name: run_automation_script
description: Executes a previously saved automation script by its name.

name: list_automation_scripts
description: Lists all saved persistent automation scripts in MEERA's library.

name: delete_automation_script
description: Deletes a saved automation script from MEERA's library.

name: take_screenshot
description: Captures a full screenshot of the user's screen and saves it as a PNG file. By default saves directly to the user's Desktop for easy access.

name: get_screen_info
description: Returns the physical screen resolution dimensions (width and height in pixels).

name: launch_application
description: Launches an application by name, executable, or protocol (e.g. 'notepad', 'calc', 'chrome', 'spotify', 'zcode', 'vscode', 'settings', 'terminal').

name: close_application
description: Closes or terminates a running application, program, File Explorer, or desktop window by name (e.g. 'file explorer', 'explorer', 'control panel', 'chrome', 'notepad', 'edge', 'settings', 'zcode').

name: find_installed_application
description: Checks whether an application, game, or program is installed on the computer. Searches Windows Start Menu (Get-StartApps), Windows Store packages, Registry installations, and PATH. Returns exact matched name, AppID or executable path, and installation status.

name: list_running_applications
description: Lists currently running user-facing desktop applications with their process names, PIDs, window titles, and RAM usage. Can also search/filter processes by name.

name: get_process_details
description: Retrieves deep diagnostic details for a running process: PID, executable path, memory (MB), CPU %, creation time, status, and open window titles.

name: control_media_playback
description: Controls media playback only. Use this for play/resume, pause, next video/track, previous video/track, or stop. Do NOT use volume actions here; use the separate volume tool for volume changes.

name: empty_recycle_bin
description: Empties the Windows Recycle Bin to permanently free up disk space.

name: lock_workstation
description: Locks the Windows computer workstation immediately, returning to the lock screen.

name: open_path_or_file
description: Opens a file, document, or directory in its default Windows associated program (e.g. a PDF in PDF reader, an image in Photos, a project folder in Explorer).

name: get_system_volume
description: Gets the current Windows master audio volume level (0-100) and mute status.

name: adjust_system_volume
description: Increases or decreases Windows master volume by a relative percent or step (e.g. delta=-10 or direction='down', delta=15 or direction='up').

name: set_system_volume
description: Sets the master Windows audio volume level between 0 and 100 percent.

name: toggle_audio_mute
description: Mutes or unmutes the master Windows audio.

name: get_system_status
description: Checks the system hardware health metrics including CPU load, RAM usage, battery percent, and OS.

name: open_web_url
description: Opens a website URL or named website (e.g. 'openai', 'netflix', 'github', 'amazon') in the default web browser. Dynamically resolves the official site headless without hardcoded links.

url.description: The URL, domain, or company/website name to open (e.g. 'https://openai.com', 'openai', 'netflix', 'github').

name: search_web_headless
description: Silently searches the live web and Google News/knowledge bases for real-time news, current events, Jensen Huang updates, tech news, Windows scripts, fixes, or information WITHOUT opening any browser windows on the user's screen. Returns parsed headlines, snippets, and answers directly into Meera's brain to speak to the user.

query.description: The topic, person, news event, technical issue, or error message to search for (e.g. 'Jensen Huang latest news', 'powershell get bluetooth battery level windows 11').

name: search_google
description: Performs a Google web search and opens the browser window ONLY and STRICTLY when the user explicitly commands to open the browser or search in browser (e.g. 'browser me search karo', 'open google in browser'). NEVER use this for background answers or technical solutions; use 'search_web_headless' instead.

name: search_youtube
description: Searches for a video, artist, or song on YouTube and opens the results page in the browser.

name: list_open_windows
description: Lists all currently open, visible desktop application windows with their titles and process IDs.

name: focus_window
description: Brings a specific application window to the foreground and focuses it.

name: minimize_window
description: Minimizes a window by name or partial title.

name: maximize_window
description: Maximizes a window by name or partial title.

name: close_window
description: Sends a clean close signal to close a window gracefully (e.g. 'File Explorer', 'Notepad', 'Chrome', 'Settings', 'Downloads', 'Control Panel').

name: get_active_window
description: Returns the title and process ID of the window currently in the foreground.

name: click_screen_element
description: Automatically scans the screen for a button, link, or text by name, smoothly glides the mouse cursor to it, and performs a click (left, right, or double-click). Also supports ordinal targeting like 'first point', 'second checkbox', or 'last option'.

target.description: The text, label, or phrase to locate and click on screen.

action.description: Action type: click (left-click), right_click, double_click, or hover.

ordinal.description: Ordinal row index: first, second, third, fourth, or last.

name: select_dropdown_item
description: Intelligently selects an option from a dropdown menu. First clicks to open the dropdown menu, waits for options to appear, scans the list, and clicks the desired item.

dropdown_target.description: The name or label of the dropdown menu to open.

item_name.description: The name of the item or option to select from the opened menu.

name: scroll_page
description: Scrolls the page with calibrated speed control and reverse direction support. Supports explicit speed percentages (e.g. '20% speed'), relative adjustments ('slower' decreases by 50%, 'faster' increases), and direction flipping ('reverse', 'down', 'up').

speed_percent.description: Speed percentage, e.g. 20 for 20% speed, 100 for default.

name: get_screen_elements
description: Returns a compact spatial coordinate table of all interactive UI elements, buttons, checkboxes, rows, and links currently on screen.

name: find_text_in_image
description: Takes an image binary file (e.g. screenshot PNG/JPG) and a target text, and returns the exact pixel coordinates (x, y, width, height, center_x, center_y) where that text appears using Windows Native OCR.

image_path.description: The absolute or relative file path to the image to scan.

target_text.description: The text, label, or word to find pixel coordinates for.

name: get_ui_elements
description: Inspects the active foreground window using Windows UI Automation to discover all interactive UI controls, input boxes, clickable buttons, dropdown menus, checkboxes, tabs, and links with their names, control types, and exact screen coordinates.
